screens.purpose: Open the storefront with the resolved delivery locale stated as a standing, tappable fact rather than a dismissible announcement.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-TopAppBar (small) — md.sys.color.surface on md.sys.elevation.level0, title in md.sys.typescale.title-large, respects the 24dp status inset
MD-SearchBar — md.sys.color.surface-container-high, md.sys.shape.corner.full, 16dp horizontal margin, 8dp below the app bar

MD-Chip (assist) 'Ships to IN · Prices in INR' — md.sys.color.secondary-container, md.sys.typescale.label-large, md.sys.shape.corner.small, 16dp margin; taps through to Delivery & currency and never auto-dismisses
MD-List of category rows — md.sys.color.surface, md.sys.typescale.body-large, 56dp row height, MD-Divider at md.sys.color.outline-variant between rows
MD-Card carousel of recent and saved items — md.sys.elevation.level1, md.sys.shape.corner.medium, 12dp gutter
MD-NavigationBar with an MD-Badge on the cart destination — md.sys.color.surface-container, 80dp tall, respects the 48dp bottom inset

states.empty: No recent or saved items: the carousel is replaced by a single MD-Card inviting a search, category rows remain.
states.loading: MD-ProgressIndicator (linear, indeterminate) under the app bar; category rows render as tonal placeholder blocks at md.sys.color.surface-container-highest.
states.error: Catalogue fetch fails: inline MD-Card at md.sys.color.error-container with a retry MD-Button; the locale MD-Chip stays live because it is read from local state, not the failed call.

data: Resolved delivery country and currency code
Category list with display names and route slugs
Recently viewed and saved items (title, thumbnail, dual-currency price)
Cart line count for the MD-Badge
interactions: Tap MD-SearchBar to push the Search screen
Tap the locale MD-Chip to push Delivery & currency
Tap a category row to push Results pre-filtered
Pull to refresh the carousel
Long-press a carousel card for a save or remove MD-Menu
data_dependencies: GET /locale/resolve returns inferred country, currency, and the confidence of the inference
GET /catalog/categories
GET /users/me/recent-items
GET /cart/summary for the badge count
Local store: user-confirmed locale override, read before the network call
edge_cases: Locale inference unavailable: the MD-Chip reads 'Set delivery country' and routes to the same screen rather than guessing
Offline on cold start: cached categories render, the carousel shows its empty state, the locale chip shows the last confirmed value
Category name overflows a single line: truncate to two lines at md.sys.typescale.body-large, never ellipsize the route
Cart badge count above 99 renders as a capped MD-Badge
User has confirmed a locale that contradicts the inference: the confirmed value always wins and no banner reappears
open_questions: Does the locale chip show the country, the currency, or both when they disagree with each other's conventions?
Should a first-ever session route straight to Delivery & currency, or open here with the inferred value already stated?

screens.purpose: Make the delivery country and display currency an explicit, once-and-done decision, with the price consequence visible before it is committed.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-TopAppBar (small) with a back MD-IconButton — md.sys.color.surface, md.sys.typescale.title-large, respects the 24dp status inset
MD-TextField (outlined) country filter — md.sys.shape.corner.extra-small, md.sys.color.surface-container-highest, 16dp margin
MD-List of countries, each row an MD-RadioButton — md.sys.typescale.body-large, 56dp rows, MD-Divider at md.sys.color.outline-variant

MD-Card live price preview pinned below the list — md.sys.color.surface-container-high, md.sys.elevation.level2, md.sys.shape.corner.large, showing one sample cart line re-priced in the pending currency
MD-Button (filled) 'Save and continue' docked above the 48dp bottom inset — md.sys.color.primary on md.sys.color.on-primary, md.sys.shape.corner.full, 56dp tall, 16dp margin

states.empty: Country filter matches nothing: the MD-List is replaced by an inline message at md.sys.typescale.body-medium offering to clear the filter.
states.loading: Re-pricing in flight: the preview MD-Card holds its previous value at md.sys.state.disabled opacity with an MD-ProgressIndicator (circular, 24dp) beside it; the save MD-Button is disabled, never hidden.
states.error: Re-pricing fails: the preview MD-Card shows the last good conversion with an inline note, and the save MD-Button stays enabled so the user is never trapped by a failed preview.

data: Supported delivery countries with display name and ISO code
Currency code and symbol per country
One representative cart or recent item to price in the preview
Currently confirmed locale, to pre-select a radio
interactions: Type in the MD-TextField to filter the country list
Select an MD-RadioButton to set the pending country and trigger a preview re-price
Tap 'Save and continue' to commit and pop back to the origin screen
Back gesture discards the pending selection without committing
MD-Snackbar confirms the commit on the destination screen, not this one
data_dependencies: GET /locale/countries
POST /pricing/preview with a pending country code and a sample item id
PUT /users/me/locale to commit the confirmed country and currency
Local store: write the confirmed locale synchronously so the next screen never re-infers
edge_cases: Selected country does not ship the sample item: the preview MD-Card says so plainly instead of showing a converted price
Currency has no minor units: the preview must not render trailing decimal places
Offline: the list renders from cache, the preview is suppressed with an inline note, and committing is still allowed
Commit succeeds locally but the PUT fails: keep the local value, retry in the background, and never silently revert the user's choice
A country served by multiple currencies requires a second radio group rather than an assumed default
open_questions: Should committing a new country clear a cart priced in the previous currency, or re-price it in place?
Is the delivery country separable from the display currency, or always coupled?

screens.purpose: Take a query and make committing it unmistakable, so suggestions assist the search instead of standing in for it.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-SearchBar in its expanded view-mode, focused on entry — md.sys.color.surface-container-high, md.sys.typescale.body-large, full-bleed, respects the 24dp status inset
Trailing submit MD-IconButton inside the search bar — md.sys.color.on-surface-variant, 48dp touch target, always present so a commit affordance exists whether or not the keyboard is up

First MD-List row is the literal query, labelled as a search for the exact words typed — md.sys.color.surface-container, md.sys.typescale.body-large, visually separated by an MD-Divider from the suggestions beneath it
MD-List of suggestions — md.sys.typescale.body-large at md.sys.color.on-surface-variant, 48dp rows
MD-Chip row of recent searches below the suggestions — md.sys.color.secondary-container, md.sys.shape.corner.small, 8dp gutter

states.empty: No query typed: suggestions are replaced by the recent-search MD-Chip row and nothing else; the submit MD-IconButton is disabled.
states.loading: Suggestions in flight: an MD-ProgressIndicator (linear, indeterminate) sits under the search bar and the literal-query row is already tappable, so a commit never waits on suggestions.
states.error: Suggestion service fails: the suggestion MD-List is omitted entirely and the literal-query row plus the submit MD-IconButton remain, so search still works.

data: Current query string
Ranked suggestion strings with their match type
Recent searches for this user, most recent first
interactions: Typing debounces a suggestion fetch without ever blocking submit
Keyboard IME action submits the literal query and navigates to Results
Tapping the submit MD-IconButton does exactly what the IME action does
Tapping the literal-query row submits that exact string
Tapping a suggestion replaces the query and submits in one step, not two
Back gesture returns to the origin screen with the query discarded
data_dependencies: GET /search/suggest with the partial query
GET /users/me/recent-searches
POST /users/me/recent-searches on a successful commit
Navigation contract: Results is pushed with the committed query string, never with a suggestion id
edge_cases: Suggestions arrive after the user has already submitted: the response is dropped, never applied to a screen that has moved on
Query is only whitespace: submit stays disabled rather than routing to an empty result set
Very long query: the search bar scrolls horizontally and the literal-query row wraps to two lines
Hardware keyboard with no IME action: the submit MD-IconButton is the guaranteed path
Fast double submit produces one navigation, not two stacked Results screens
open_questions: Should a suggestion tap be distinguishable in analytics from a literal-query commit, given the direction treats them as the same act?

screens.purpose: List what the query returned, carrying the locale forward on every price so no result has to be mentally converted.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-TopAppBar (small) holding the committed query and a back MD-IconButton — md.sys.color.surface, md.sys.typescale.title-medium, respects the 24dp status inset

MD-Chip (assist) restating the active locale — md.sys.color.secondary-container, md.sys.typescale.label-large, 16dp margin, taps through to Delivery & currency and returns here with the list re-priced in place
Result count line — md.sys.typescale.label-medium at md.sys.color.on-surface-variant, 16dp margin, 8dp below the chip

MD-List of result MD-Cards — md.sys.elevation.level1, md.sys.shape.corner.medium, 8dp vertical gutter, 16dp horizontal margin; each card stacks thumbnail, title at md.sys.typescale.title-small, rating line at md.sys.typescale.body-small, and the price at md.sys.typescale.title-medium with the secondary-currency line directly beneath at md.sys.typescale.body-small
MD-Divider at md.sys.color.outline-variant before the paging sentinel
MD-NavigationBar with the cart MD-Badge — md.sys.color.surface-container, 80dp tall, respects the 48dp bottom inset

states.empty: Zero results: a single centred block at md.sys.typescale.body-large restating the query, with the recent-search MD-Chip row beneath it as the way out.
states.loading: First page in flight: six placeholder MD-Cards at md.sys.color.surface-container-highest; subsequent pages append an MD-ProgressIndicator (circular, 24dp) at the list foot without displacing loaded rows.
states.error: Result fetch fails: an inline MD-Card at md.sys.color.error-container with a retry MD-Button, keeping any already-loaded page visible above it.

data: Committed query string and total match count
Per result: id, title, thumbnail, rating value, rating count, primary price, secondary-currency price, availability
Active locale country and both currency codes
Cart line count for the MD-Badge
interactions: Tap a result MD-Card to push Product
Scroll to the sentinel to append the next page
Pull to refresh re-runs the committed query
Tap the locale MD-Chip to change locale and return with prices re-rendered without losing scroll position
Back gesture returns to Search with the query still in the bar
data_dependencies: GET /search/results with the query, page cursor, and locale
GET /pricing/convert for the secondary-currency line, or the same field served inline by the results endpoint
GET /cart/summary for the badge
Scroll position and page cursor retained across a locale change
edge_cases: Secondary-currency conversion is unavailable for one result: that card shows the primary price alone rather than a placeholder or a stale rate
An item is out of stock for the selected delivery country: the card is dimmed at md.sys.state.disabled opacity and states why
Locale changes mid-scroll: prices re-render in place and scroll position is preserved
Result title runs long: clamp to two lines and never truncate the price line
Paging returns a duplicate id across pages: de-duplicate before render
open_questions: When primary and secondary currency are the same, is the second line hidden or shown as a confirmation?

screens.purpose: Present one product with the add action permanently within reach, so the primary act of the session is never scrolled away from or confused with checkout.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-TopAppBar (small, collapsing on scroll) with back and share MD-IconButtons — md.sys.color.surface, md.sys.elevation.level0 rising to level2 on scroll, respects the 24dp status inset
Media MD-Card — md.sys.shape.corner.large, 4:3 ratio, 16dp horizontal margin
Title at md.sys.typescale.headline-small, then the rating line at md.sys.typescale.body-medium at md.sys.color.on-surface-variant
Price block — primary at md.sys.typescale.headline-medium, secondary-currency line directly beneath at md.sys.typescale.body-medium, then the delivery-locale MD-Chip on the same row
MD-SegmentedButton for variant selection where the product has variants — md.sys.color.secondary-container for the selected segment, 48dp tall
MD-List of specification rows separated by MD-Divider at md.sys.color.outline-variant — md.sys.typescale.body-medium

Docked action bar above the 48dp bottom inset — md.sys.color.surface-container-high at md.sys.elevation.level3, md.sys.shape.corner.large on its top corners, holding a quantity stepper of two MD-IconButtons and a filled MD-Button 'Add to cart' at 56dp tall spanning the remaining width; it reserves its own layout height so it never overlaps the specification list, and it holds no checkout affordance

states.empty: Product has no media: the media MD-Card renders a tonal placeholder at md.sys.color.surface-container-highest rather than collapsing, so the docked bar never jumps position.
states.loading: Details in flight: media and specification rows render as tonal placeholders while the docked action bar is present and disabled, so its position is established before content arrives.
states.error: Detail fetch fails: an MD-Card at md.sys.color.error-container with a retry MD-Button replaces the body; the docked bar is hidden because there is nothing to add.

data: Product id, title, media set, description, specification rows
Rating value, rating count, recent purchase volume
Primary and secondary-currency price, discount percentage if any
Variant axes and per-variant availability and price
Selected quantity, defaulting to one
Availability for the active delivery country
interactions: Scroll the body while the docked action bar stays fixed at every offset
Tap the quantity MD-IconButtons to step the amount, floored at one
Tap 'Add to cart' to post the line and surface the persistent cart bar
Select an MD-SegmentedButton segment to switch variant and re-price in place
Tap the locale MD-Chip to change delivery country and return with the price re-rendered
Back gesture returns to Results at its retained scroll position
data_dependencies: GET /products/{id} with the active locale
GET /products/{id}/variants
POST /cart/lines with product id, variant id, and quantity
GET /cart/summary to refresh the persistent bar after the post
Local store: the confirmed locale, read before the product call so the first render is already correctly priced
edge_cases: Variant is out of stock for the delivery country: the segment is disabled at md.sys.state.disabled opacity with the reason stated, and the docked MD-Button is disabled rather than removed
Add fails after the tap: the docked MD-Button returns to its enabled label and an MD-Snackbar states the failure with a retry action
Price changes between render and add: the cart response is authoritative and the difference is stated explicitly, never absorbed silently
Very long title: clamp to three lines; the price block and docked bar never move as a result
Software keyboard is not involved on this screen, so the docked bar has no keyboard-avoidance case, but a device with a gesture bar must still keep the 48dp bottom inset clear
Add tapped twice quickly posts one line with quantity two, not two lines
open_questions: Should the docked bar show the running cart subtotal after a successful add, or stay a pure add control with the subtotal living only in the cart bar?

screens.purpose: Hold the outcome of every add as durable, reviewable state, so the confirmation the shopper acted on is still there when they come back to it.
screens.layout: compact <600dp -> 1-col, 16dp margin, bottom MD-NavigationBar; medium -> MD-NavigationRail, 24dp margin; expanded -> list-detail, MD-NavigationRail retained
hierarchy: MD-TopAppBar (small) with a back MD-IconButton — md.sys.color.surface, md.sys.typescale.title-large, respects the 24dp status inset
MD-Chip (assist) restating the delivery locale and currency — md.sys.color.secondary-container, 16dp margin

MD-List of line MD-Cards — md.sys.elevation.level1, md.sys.shape.corner.medium, 8dp gutter; each carries thumbnail, title at md.sys.typescale.title-small, a quantity stepper of two MD-IconButtons, the line price at md.sys.typescale.title-medium and its secondary-currency line at md.sys.typescale.body-small
MD-Divider at md.sys.color.outline-variant above the totals block
Totals block — subtotal label at md.sys.typescale.body-large and value at md.sys.typescale.headline-small, with the secondary-currency total beneath at md.sys.typescale.body-medium
Docked MD-Button (filled) 'Proceed to checkout' above the 48dp bottom inset — md.sys.color.primary, md.sys.shape.corner.full, 56dp tall, 16dp margin, reserving its own layout height
MD-NavigationBar beneath it — md.sys.color.surface-container, 80dp tall

states.empty: No lines: a centred block at md.sys.typescale.body-large with a single MD-Button routing back to Shop home; the docked checkout MD-Button is not rendered.
states.loading: Cart fetch in flight: two placeholder line MD-Cards at md.sys.color.surface-container-highest with the totals block suppressed rather than showing a zero that will change.
states.error: Cart fetch fails: an MD-Card at md.sys.color.error-container with a retry MD-Button; the last known line count remains visible so the shopper is never told their cart is empty when it is not.

data: Cart lines: product id, variant, title, thumbnail, quantity, unit price, line price in both currencies
Subtotal in both currencies
Active delivery country and currency
Per-line availability for the active country
interactions: Step a line quantity with the MD-IconButtons and re-total in place
Step to zero to open an MD-Dialog confirming removal
Undo a removal from the MD-Snackbar that follows it
Tap the locale MD-Chip to change delivery country and return with every line re-priced
Pull to refresh re-reads the cart
Tap 'Proceed to checkout' to leave this flow
data_dependencies: GET /cart with the active locale
PATCH /cart/lines/{id} for a quantity change
DELETE /cart/lines/{id} for a removal, with an undo window before it is final
GET /pricing/convert for the secondary-currency totals
Local store: the confirmed locale, so the cart is never priced in an inferred currency
edge_cases: A line becomes unavailable for the newly selected delivery country: the card is dimmed at md.sys.state.disabled opacity, excluded from the subtotal, and the exclusion is stated above the total
Quantity exceeds the stock cap: the stepper clamps and states the cap rather than failing on checkout
Cart mutated in another session: a refresh reconciles and states which lines changed instead of overwriting silently
Removal undo tapped after the DELETE has committed: re-add the line and say so, rather than failing quietly
Subtotal and secondary-currency total disagree because of a rate refresh mid-session: show the primary as authoritative and timestamp the conversion
Zero lines reached by removal rather than by arriving empty: the docked MD-Button animates out, it does not vanish between frames
open_questions: How long does the removal undo window stay open, and does leaving the screen commit it immediately?
Does the persistent cart bar from Product remain visible on this screen, or is it redundant here?

design_system_gaps.need: A non-modal action bar docked above the navigation bar that holds a price, a quantity stepper, and the primary add control at every scroll offset, and that reserves its own layout height instead of floating over content.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: An extended FAB is a single floating action with a label and no surface for quantity, price, or a disabled-with-reason state, and it overlays the content it accompanies rather than reserving space. MD-BottomSheet is the only other docked surface and it is modal and draggable, which blocks the very content the bar is supposed to sit alongside.

design_system_gaps.need: A persistent cart-state bar that survives scrolling and navigation, carrying the running subtotal and an undo for the last add.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: MD-Snackbar is transient by specification: it auto-dismisses, carries at most one action, and is explicitly not for state that must remain readable. That transience is precisely the failure this direction exists to fix, so using it would re-create the problem in a Material-compliant wrapper.

design_system_gaps.need: A standing locale indicator that is simultaneously informative, actionable, and not dismissible, stating both the delivery country and the display currency.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: An assist MD-Chip is the closest fit and is what the spec uses, but it carries no persistent-state semantics, no room for a two-part value when country and currency disagree, and no affordance signalling that it reflects live system state rather than an optional filter. The Material component that reads as a system statement is a banner, which is dismissible by definition.
